snippet.title: Economy Bros Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
This is the official trailer for the release of the demo of the Economy Bros now available to play on Steam! Check it out, and also join our discord!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248620/The_Economy_Bros/

https://discord.gg/bsd9G38QSy 

Song in video license:

"Raving Energy" Kevin Macleod (incompetech.com)
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License
http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

I apologize for the quality, when went to record this I could not figure out how to get the quality to perfect 1080p when trying to record my screen. HD screenshots are available on the steam page.

Content Creators feel free to use this footage, and you can request access for the full unreleased game via the steam curators or message me on discord "RawSkillz1810" labeled as the developer in the discord server.
